“Unlock the cages, Theron, or I’ll open them with your bones.”  
Theron laughs and snaps his fingers. A hooked blade cuts for your ribs while the captives hammer the wagon bars.🔊………

The axle groans under the assault, giving you hard cover while Theron’s men circle through the ash. Theron points toward the wagon’s rear, and a slaver begins hacking at the wheel to bring the whole barricade down.🔊………

log.action: Shout to the captives, urging them to brace the cages.

Theron’s smile hardens, and he orders the remaining killers to cut the captives loose and use them as shields. The wounded slaver bucks against your grip, seeking to wrench free and open your guard.🔊………

log.action: Finish the wounded slaver with a longsword thrust.

Theron answers with a curse and draws a black-headed axe, stepping over the dead man as the captives roar behind their bars.🔊………

log.action: Talk things over with Theron Wyndfall.

Turn 9 | Day 1, 6:14 pmInsight checkd20: 9 -- failedTheron keeps the axe poised while the dead slaver’s blood darkens the ash between you. He does not lower his weapon, but the captives’ sudden silence makes room for his bargain.  
“You still have the old strength, Korrag. Stand beside me, and the cages become your command. Refuse, and I carve you open for the rites.”  
His gaze flicks toward the branded corpse, and a black spark crawls across the axe head. The bargain is a snare, not mercy.🔊………

log.action: Follow the wagon trail east into the Blighted Reach.
log.narration:
Turn 16 | Day 1, 9:02 pmThe wagon trail narrows between dead thorn trees, and ash hisses beneath your boots. By late afternoon it ends at a sunken warehouse of black stone, its iron grate sealed beneath a skull-marked lintel. Kadrun Zethran steps from the ruin with a hooked blade in hand, his gaze fixed on the key at your belt.  
    
"Turn back, Northlander. The dead road has swallowed enough men today."  
The grate groans behind him. Something massive shifts in the darkness, dragging chains across stone.🔊………

log.action: Examine the black iron key for markings or magical residue.
log.narration: Turn 17 | Day 1, 9:22 pmInvestigation checkd20: 16 -- successThe key is cold enough to numb your fingers. You scrape ash from its teeth and find a tiny skull cut into the bow, ringed by three hooked strokes that match the lintel above the grate. No spell answers your touch, but green residue glimmers in the grooves, the same sick color as the vial taken from Theron. Kadrun watches your hands, and his hooked blade rises a finger’s breadth.🔊………

log.action: Brace for the chained creature and watch the darkness.
log.narration: Turn 18 | Day 1, 1:00 amYou plant your boots before the grate and lower your center of gravity. The darkness behind the iron bars erupts, and a chained thing crawls into the ash on six jointed limbs, its hide plated in wet black scales. Its blind skull turns toward your heartbeat while the chain around its throat snaps taut.🔊………

log.action: Inspect the green residue without touching it.
log.narration: Turn 19 | Day 1, 1:01 amInvestigation checkd20: 14 -- successChained hollow-beast attackd20: 16 -- hitChained hollow-beast damaged20: 5 -- 5 damage, Shield Wall reduces to 2You crouch beside the grate and study the residue through a veil of ash. Its sheen crawls against the iron, moving toward the warmth of your face. The hollow-beast lunges, chains shrieking, and one hooked limb tears across your braced guard.🔊………

log.action: Strike the chained creature before it reaches me.
log.narration: Turn 20 | Day 1, 1:02 amLongsword attackd20: 18 -- hitPower Strike damaged20: 5 -- damageLongsword damaged20: 7 -- damageYou meet the creature’s rush with a savage two-handed cut. Steel cleaves through its plated shoulder, and black fluid spatters the ash as the chain jerks it sideways. It remains upright, shrieking through a mouth that has no tongue.🔊………

log.action: Raise my shield and hold against the hollow-beast’s next lunge.
log.narration: Turn 21 | Day 1, 1:03 amChained hollow-beast attackd20: 15 -- hitChained hollow-beast damaged20: 6 -- 6 damage, Shield Wall reduces to 3You have no shield, so you brace your longsword across your body and lock your feet in the ash. The hollow-beast hurls itself at you, but its hooked limb crashes against your guard and skids away in a shower of sparks.🔊………

log.action: Seize the creature’s chain and wrench it sideways.
log.narration: Turn 22 | Day 1, 1:04 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYou seize the chain as it whips past and haul with all the iron in your back. The beast’s charge tears you across the ash, but your boots bite stone and the chain snaps tight around its throat. Its skull slams against the grate, and the creature sprawls within reach of your blade.🔊………

log.action: Drive my axe into the hollow-beast’s wounded flank.
log.narration: Turn 23 | Day 1, 1:05 amBlack-headed axe attackd20: 17 -- hitBlack-headed axe damaged20: 9 -- hitYou wrench the chain hard and bury the black-headed axe in the beast’s wounded flank. The blade chops through scale and bone, and the hollow thing collapses against the grate in a burst of fetid steam.🔊………

log.action: Drive my longsword into the hollow-beast’s exposed throat.
log.narration: Turn 24 | Day 1, 1:06 amYour longsword drives into the corpse’s throat and strikes the grate beneath. No blood answers the blow, only a hollow clang and a spill of black vapor. Beyond the bars, a hidden mechanism groans, and the sealed gate lifts a handspan before stopping.🔊………

log.action: Unlock the sealed grate with the black iron key.
log.narration:
Turn 25 | Day 1, 1:16 amThe key slips from your fingers as the old wounds open beneath your mail. You fall hard in the ash, and the warehouse gate rises while Kadrun Zethran steps through its narrow gap. He drags you inside by the collar, not from mercy, but to keep his prize alive.  
     A man’s voice comes from the dark beyond the threshold. It bears the rasp of a fighter who has swallowed too much blood. A brand burns through his bare chest, and iron shackles bite both wrists.  
"Wake, Northlander. The marked dog wants to see the man who escaped the pit."  
"He has been asking for death."🔊………

log.action: Study the hidden mechanism beneath the lifted grate.
log.narration:
Turn 26 | Day 1, 1:26 amInvestigation checkd20: 13 -- failedThe grate’s lifting teeth are not meant to open a door. They draw a hooked chain beneath the floor, where a bronze seal throbs with green light. Your eyes catch the murder in the design, a counterweight ready to drop the grate and crush whoever stands beneath it.  
        The branded fighter lifts his head. His eyes are clear for one breath, and the voice behind them is a voice from the pits, scarred but unmistakable.  
"Korrag. Do not touch the seal."  Kadrun’s hooked blade rises toward your ribs as the bronze beneath the grate begins to turn.  
"The master paid well for you breathing. Grim Saltborn will earn the rest by breaking you."🔊………

log.action: Study the burning brand for sorcerous signs.
log.narration: Turn 27 | Day 1, 1:36 amArcana checkd20: unattempted -- cannot meaningfully attempt Arcana untrainedYou study the brand through the smoke, but its strokes refuse every pattern you know. Sorcery crawls beneath Grim Saltborn’s skin, and the mark answers your gaze with a pulse that makes your teeth ache.🔊………

log.action: Kick Kadrun's hooked blade aside.
log.narration:
Turn 28 | Day 1, 1:37 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYour boot slams into Kadrun’s wrist. The hooked blade spins across the stone and strikes the bronze seal with a shriek of sparks.  
        Kadrun staggers back, then bares his teeth and reaches beneath his coat. Grim Saltborn convulses in the shackles as the brand flares white green. The bronze seal turns another notch, and the stone beneath your boots gives a hungry click.🔊………

log.action: Search the shackles for a release mechanism.
log.narration:
Turn 29 | Day 1, 1:38 amInvestigation checkd20: 16 -- successYou wrench your attention from Kadrun and scour the shackles. Beneath Grim Saltborn’s left wrist, your fingers find a recessed catch hidden under old blood. The iron bites your hand as Kadrun lunges, forcing you to choose between the mechanism and the blade he draws from his sleeve.  
        You find the release catch, but it is linked to a second lock beneath the bronze seal. Opening the shackles alone will trigger the counterweight and crush Grim against the platform. Grim’s brand flares again, and something below the stairwell answers with a slow iron knock.🔊………

log.action: Strike Kadrun before he draws another weapon.
log.narration:
Turn 30 | Day 1, 1:39 amStrength attackd20: 15 -- successLongsword damaged20: 7 -- damageYou drive your longsword at Kadrun’s throat before the hidden blade clears his coat. He twists aside, and steel opens his shoulder instead, splashing dark blood across the bronze seal.  
     Kadrun snarls and tears the sleeve free. The knife flashes in his fist as the stairwell answers with another iron knock. Grim’s shackles strain against their bolts, and the brand beneath his ribs burns brighter.🔊………

log.action: Call down the stairwell and listen for an answer.
log.narration:
Turn 31 | Day 1, 1:40 amPerception checkd20: 12 -- successYour voice plunges down the narrow stairwell and dies among the stones. For a heartbeat, only Grim’s chains answer. Then something below drags a heavy edge across rock, and a breath rises through the dark, wet and patient.  
   "That is not a man."  Kadrun’s face loses its color. He lunges for the recessed catch beneath Grim’s wrist, not to free him, but to wrench the mechanism open. The bronze seal grinds beneath the platform as the unseen thing begins climbing.🔊………

log.action: Seize Grim’s recessed catch and hold it shut.
log.narration:
Turn 32 | Day 1, 1:41 amStrength checkd20: 18 -- successYou clamp your hand over the recessed catch and lock your arm. The mechanism bucks beneath your palm, but iron and muscle hold it fast.  
       Kadrun’s knife slashes for your wrist. You wrench Grim’s shackles sideways, and the blade bites the iron instead of your flesh. Below, the unseen horror reaches the stair’s final step. Its claws scrape the floor.🔊………

log.action: Strike Kadrun’s knife hand with my longsword.
log.narration:
Turn 33 | Day 1, 1:42 amStrength attackd20: 16 -- successLongsword damaged20: 6 -- damageYour longsword snaps across the chamber and catches Kadrun’s knife hand. Bone cracks beneath the steel, and his hidden blade clatters beside the bronze seal.  
      Kadrun collapses against the platform, clutching the ruined hand. The thing from below rises into the green light, a tall shape wrapped in iron chains, with a jaw that opens sideways. Grim screams as his brand answers it.🔊………

log.action: Strike Kadrun’s knife hand with my longsword.
log.narration:
Turn 34 | Day 1, 1:43 amYour blade descends, but Kadrun’s ruined hand is already limp. The point punches stone beside him, and the last red thread leaves his body as the chained horror towers over the platform.  
  
        
  
   The horror’s sideways jaws gape above you. Grim Saltborn’s brand answers with a flash that scorches the shackles, and the bronze seal begins to split.🔊………

log.action: Drive the longsword into the horror’s opening jaw.
log.narration:
Turn 35 | Day 1, 1:44 amStrength attackd20: 17 -- successLongsword damaged20: 8 -- damageYou drive the longsword into the horror’s sideways maw. The blade bites through black cartilage, but the jaws clamp hard enough to wrench your shoulders nearly from their sockets.  
  
       The creature tears its head free and surges toward Grim. Chains lash from its flesh like living serpents. The bronze seal cracks open beneath the platform, and green fire spills into the chamber.🔊………

log.action: Drag Grim away from the splitting bronze seal.
log.narration:
Turn 36 | Day 1, 1:45 amStrength checkd20: 19 -- successYou seize Grim Saltborn beneath the arms and wrench him from the platform. His shackles grind over stone as you haul him beyond the seal’s killing circle.  
   The chained horror strikes through the green blaze. Its iron links rake your side, but your mail turns the worst of it aside. Grim lands hard beside Kadrun’s corpse while the bronze seal splits behind you.🔊………

log.action: Kick Kadrun’s knife beneath the central platform.
log.narration: Turn 37 | Day 1, 1:46 amYou kick Kadrun’s knife beneath the iron platform. It skitters into the green glare and vanishes beneath the broken seal.🔊………

log.action: Order Grim to crawl toward the stairwell.
log.narration:
Turn 38 | Day 1, 1:47 amIntimidation checkd20: 15 -- success"Crawl to the stairwell, Grim. Keep your head down."Grim Saltborn obeys, dragging his shackled legs across the stone. The chained horror turns toward him, and the green fire gutters in its hollow chest.  
    He reaches the stairwell’s first step. Something below answers with a wet iron scrape, and the darkness exhales against his face.🔊………

log.action: Order Grim to crawl toward the stairwell.
log.narration:
Turn 39 | Day 1, 1:48 amGrim Saltborn claws at the stair’s edge, then freezes as hooked fingers curl from the darkness below.  
"No farther. It is waiting for me."The chained horror lurches across the burning platform, dragging its iron length toward him. Grim’s brand flares through his skin, and the stairwell answers with a hungry clank.🔊………

log.action: Use the iron platform to block the horror’s path.
log.narration:
Turn 40 | Day 1, 1:49 amStrength checkd20: 18 -- successYou slam both hands against the iron platform and heave. The structure screeches across the stone, shedding sparks as its edge crashes between Grim Saltborn and the chained horror.  
    The horror smashes into the barrier. Green fire bursts across its chains, and the platform holds for one precious breath. Grim Saltborn crawls down the first steps, but the darkness below answers with a wet rasp.🔊………

log.action: Use the iron platform to block the horror’s path.
log.narration:
Turn 41 | Day 1, 1:50 amStrength checkd20: 9 -- failedChained horror attackd20: 16 -- hitChained horror damaged20: 5 -- damageYou wrench at the platform again, but iron has no mercy left to give. The chained horror drives its weight into the barrier, and the metal buckles toward you.  
   A hooked chain lashes over the platform and tears across your mail. Blood darkens your side as the barrier skids toward the stairwell.🔊………

log.action: Hold the platform steady against the chained horror.
log.narration:
Turn 42 | Day 1, 1:51 amStrength checkd20: 14 -- failedChained horror attackd20: 18 -- hitChained horror damaged20: 4 -- damageYou brace your boots against the broken stone and seize the platform’s rim. The chained horror hammers the iron with its full weight, and your wounded side burns like a furnace.  
     The platform gives way. It crushes your knee against the floor before tearing free, and the horror bursts through toward Grim Saltborn.🔊………

log.action: Pull Grim back from the stairwell’s first step.
log.narration:
Turn 43 | Day 1, 1:52 amStrength checkd20: 17 -- successYou hook one hand into Grim Saltborn’s chains and haul him backward from the first step. The stairwell claws at him with unseen force, but you tear him free as the chained horror crashes through the buckled platform.  
      The horror’s chain catches your crushed knee and jerks you across the stone. Pain blacks the edges of your sight, and Grim’s shackles ring against the floor as the creature pulls both of you toward the opened stairwell.🔊………

log.action: Slash the chain dragging I toward the stairwell.
log.narration:
Turn 44 | Day 1, 1:53 amStrength attackd20: 7 -- failedChained horror attackd20: 15 -- hitChained horror damaged20: 4 -- damageYour crushed knee folds as you swing from the floor. The longsword hacks through one iron link, but the severed chain lashes back and pins your wrist against the stone.  
          Grim Saltborn drags himself behind the fallen platform, while the horror pulls you toward the stairwell. Ash spills from a torn brand on its chain, bearing the same hooked sign stamped into the black iron key.  
"The camps feed it. Valerius keeps them beyond the ash road."🔊………

log.action: Slash the chain dragging I toward the stairwell.
log.narration:
Turn 45 | Day 1, 1:54 amStrength attackd20: 16 -- successChained horror attackd20: 13 -- missYour arm moves before your failing body can obey. The sword bites the iron tether and opens a jagged crack.  
   The horror wrenches the chain free from the broken seal, and the recoil flings you into the wreckage. Grim Saltborn seizes your belt and hauls you clear as the stairwell erupts with a breath of grave-cold air.🔊………

log.action: Crawl behind the fallen platform toward Grim Saltborn.
log.narration:
Turn 46 | Day 1, 1:59 amConstitution saving throwd20: 9 -- failedYour hands claw at the ash, but your strength has run out. You crawl a single arm’s length before darkness takes you, and your sword slips from your fingers. Grim Saltborn drags you behind the fallen platform, then crouches over you as green seepage bubbles from the shattered seal.  
   "Stay breathing, Northlander. That poison runs beneath the city. Find its heart, or Ashenveil will rot from below."The words fade beneath the pounding in your skull. You remain alive, but helpless, while the stairwell breathes cold into the ruined chamber.🔊………

log.action: Search the wreckage for Kadrun’s hooked knife.
log.narration:
Turn 47 | Day 1, 2:09 amInvestigation checkd20: 6 -- failedYour fingers grope through ash and splintered iron, but the chamber tilts beneath you. Grim Saltborn finds the hooked knife first and presses its hilt into your palm before your eyes close.  
   Grim binds your torn flesh with a strip ripped from his own garment. The crude pressure stops the worst of the bleeding, and you drag breath back into your ruined chest.  
"This seal bears a council mark. Someone in Ashenveil paid for these chains."A black wax fragment clings to the wreckage, stamped with a serpent coiled around a tower. Grim stares at it with naked dread.🔊………

log.action: Press a scrap against the shattered seal’s green seepage.
log.narration:
Turn 48 | Day 1, 2:15 amInvestigation checkd20: 15 -- successYou press the scrap to the green seepage. The wax blackens, then peels apart in your fingers as the seal answers with a pulse that shakes dust from the rafters.  
  Letters burn across the scrap in a language you cannot read. Grim Saltborn recoils as the mark on his flesh flares beneath its chains.  
"Do not touch it again. The seal is calling something below."A thin crack opens in the stone, and a wet, rootlike tendril noses through from the darkness under the warehouse. The shattered bronze is no longer merely broken. It is opening.🔊………

log.action: Have Grim help me reach the stairwell.
log.narration:
Turn 49 | Day 1, 2:18 amConstitution checkd20: 13 -- successGrim Saltborn wedges his shoulder beneath your arm and drags you across the wreckage. Each step sends fire through your ruined leg, while the tendril coils behind you and scrapes grooves into the stone.  
       You reach the stairwell’s lip, but the darkness below is no empty shaft. Green light pulses far beneath, and something massive shifts against the buried steps. Grim tightens his grip as the warehouse floor groans behind you.  
"The thing below knows we are here."The opening widens by the breadth of a hand, spilling foul heat over your boots.🔊………

log.action: Cover the green seepage with the fallen platform.
log.narration:
Turn 50 | Day 1, 2:20 amStrength checkd20: 16 -- successYou plant your good leg and drive both hands against the fallen platform. The iron mass shifts across the stone, grinding over the green seepage and spraying hot slime through the cracks.  
  The platform settles over the wound in the floor. The tendril vanishes beneath it, but the metal buckles as something below strikes once, hard enough to throw you against Grim Saltborn.🔊………
